scope.single_experimental_change: replace the audited V7 window-anchor proposal with a candidate exact point-query sampler specification and audit that candidate

point_query_contract.multiplicity: a count k remains one query position whose target is k; it is never inserted k times into a draw pool
point_query_contract.public_event_expansion: a predicted count k expands later into k anonymous events with the same type and position
point_query_contract.context_interval: audio[max(0,t-4092):t+1] with zero initialization only before sample zero
point_query_contract.exclusive_end_offsets: excluded because no acoustic sample t=frame_count exists

strata.partition_requirement: each supervised sample belongs to exactly one stratum
strata.within_positive_stratum_sampling: uniform over unique track/sample positions with replacement
strata.within_background_sampling: uniform over all background samples globally with replacement, implemented by a uniform global frame draw followed by rejection of boundary positions

prior_correction.live_stratum_probability: p_s = number of full-stream samples in stratum s / total full-stream samples
prior_correction.sampled_stratum_probability: q_s = fixed draws from stratum s / total fixed draws
prior_correction.normalization: the sampled mean importance weight must equal one analytically
prior_correction.use_in_this_experiment: audit only; no loss is selected or implemented

full_stream: joint histogram of onset_count and offset_count
per-head exact count histograms and event mass
player, arrangement and track frame distributions
fixed_draws: importance-weight distribution and effective sample size
objective_diagnostics_only: positive and negative loss mass per head
constant categorical optimum before and after prior correction
historical threshold 0.55 decision without changing that threshold
expected draws and probability of observing every nonzero count class over 20 historical epochs
required_audit.before_after: compare the candidate sampler both to the full live stream and to the audited V7 sampler

training_readiness_guard.fixed_draw_empirical_prior_error: report only; it is stochastic and cannot override an exact analytical correction
training_readiness_guard.unweighted_sampler_live_calibration: reject whenever its class prior differs from the full stream
